title: Recursion over lists
hints: Every function needs a clause for [] and a clause for [head | tail].
sum with an accumulator: def sum(list), do: sum(list, 0), then defp sum([], acc), do: acc and defp sum([head | tail], acc), do: sum(tail, acc + head)
reverse: carry a second list and put each head on the front of it: reverse(tail, [head | acc])
